prompts.mermaid: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: three-pose transparent sprite MODEL SHEET for Little Weeps. Use the supplied character as the identity reference. Create a WIDE 3:2 sheet with exactly THREE equal-width vertical cells, one full character in each cell, ordered left to right. Each cell has large transparent margins, entire body and tail visible, roughly same body size across poses, characters never overlap or cross cell boundaries. Truly transparent alpha outside each silhouette; no black background, glow, shadow, water, splash, text, labels, borders or grid lines. Keep the clean Bluey-inspired cartoon outlines and colors of the source. All poses travel toward the RIGHT. The three poses must be distinct drawings, with changes to limbs, tail and body curvature rather than three rotated copies. LEFT: EMERGING, head/upper body pointing up and right at 50 degrees, tail down, beginning to rise out of the water. MIDDLE: AIRBORNE, body lifted in a graceful horizontal arc, head to right, lively arms/flippers and curved tail, midair apex. RIGHT: RE-ENTERING, head/body pointing down and right at 50 degrees, tail lifted behind, streamlined dive back into the water. Draw each COMPLETE body even for emerging and diving; the game separately masks the waterline. Character: the same friendly Hispanic mermaid requested by the user, now with LIGHT warm brown/honey-tan skin (approximately #DBAA7C, substantially lighter than the source). Apply the same light-brown skin to face, neck, arms, hands and exposed belly in ALL THREE POSES. Preserve coral-pink curly hair, lavender short-sleeve swim top, turquoise scaly fish tail and broad split tail fins. Emerging arms reaching up; airborne arms waving open; diving arms extending forward toward entry. Hair follows each motion.

layoutCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied three-pose model sheet. Preserve the identity, colors, light/dark tone and exact THREE distinct poses of this character. Re-layout it as a 2 by 2 transparent animation atlas, wide 3:2 aspect, not a single horizontal row. Each cell is exactly HALF the canvas width and HALF the canvas height. Top LEFT: emerging pose. Top RIGHT: airborne pose. Bottom LEFT: diving/re-entry pose. Bottom RIGHT: completely empty transparent. Scale the drawings down as needed, preserve aspect ratio, ensure comparable anatomical body size across all three poses.
